title: Head of Growth
description:
The role

The Head of Growth owns every paid route to a new TALA customer. You will set the acquisition strategy, own the media budget and be measured on the new customers it brings in. The role leads the Growth pillar of the Digital & Customer team, and is central to taking TALA from c. £30m to £100m+ in revenue.

You will lead a small in-house team and our agency partners, work closely with brand, creative and the Customer and Digital Experience teams, and grow TALA into new channels and new markets.

What you will be accountable for

You will be responsible for new customer growth and the efficiency of every pound spent to acquire it.

  • Deliver new customer volume, CAC and first-order contribution targets across all paid channels

  • Own the acquisition budget and its allocation across channels, markets and campaigns against CAC, ROAS, blended MER and payback

  • Build the annual and in-season acquisition plan with finance, including new customer targets, media budgets and forecasts

  • Grow the share of high-value new customers, working with your peers in the customer team on cohort and lifetime value data

  • Report weekly and monthly on acquisition performance, trade-offs and recommendations to the Digital & Customer Director and leadership team

Paid media and channels

  • Own paid social across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and Snapchat, including prospecting, retargeting and creator partnership ads

  • Own paid search and shopping, including brand, non-brand and Performance Max

  • Own video and programmatic, using upper-funnel media to build reach and demand alongside direct response

  • Own affiliates and partnerships, including publisher, content and strategic brand partners

  • Run a structured test, learn and scale approach to new channels, such as TikTok Shop

  • Build TALA's visibility in AI search and shopping, including ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode, working with the Head of Digital Experience

  • Manage the trading calendar for paid media around launches, drops, collaborations and key promotional moments, with merchandising and brand

Measurement and insight

  • Own the acquisition measurement framework, combining platform data, attribution, incrementality testing and media mix modelling

  • Run an ongoing programme of incrementality tests, including geo-lift and holdout studies, and use the results to set budgets

  • Measure the effect of paid media on store sales as well as online, as TALA becomes more omnichannel

  • Work with the Head of Digital Experience on tracking, attribution and server-side data, so the numbers are trusted across the business

  • Partner with finance and the data team on a single view of CAC, MER and payback

Creative and brand

  • Partner with the brand and creative teams on performance creative, setting briefs from channel and audience insight

  • Build a high-volume creative testing programme across formats, hooks and talent, and feed the results back into brand and product

  • Use AI tools to increase the volume and speed of creative production and testing, keeping all work on brand

  • Work closely with the Brand Marketing Director on PR, influencer, creator and community activity, and put paid spend behind what works

  • Protect the TALA brand in every paid placement, balancing short-term returns with long-term brand building

New markets and growth

  • Lead paid acquisition for international market launches, from test budgets and localisation to scaling in each market

  • Support store openings, including Edinburgh, with local awareness and footfall campaigns

  • Work with the Customer team on referral, reactivation and lapsed-customer acquisition

  • Partner with the Head of Digital Experience on landing pages, conversion and SEO, so paid traffic converts

Team and agency leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop a small team of acquisition specialists

  • Decide the right mix of in-house capability and agency partners, and manage agency relationships, briefs, fees and performance

  • Manage the growth technology stack, including attribution, analytics, affiliate and creative tools, with clear return on each

  • Lead the use of AI across the growth function, building it into media buying, budget allocation, creative, analysis and reporting

  • Build the team's AI skills, with the right tools, training and clear guidelines on brand, data and privacy

  • Build a culture of experimentation, pace and ownership of results

  • Stay hands-on in the platforms and the numbers

About you

You are a commercial growth marketer who has scaled paid acquisition for a fast-growing consumer brand. You are as comfortable in a contribution model as you are in Ads Manager, and you’re equally passionate about our brand and product as you are about working in one of the fastest-paced disciplines in marketing.

Experience

  • 8-10+ years in performance or growth marketing, with at least 3 years leading a team, ideally in high-growth DTC fashion, activewear or beauty

  • A proven record of scaling new customer acquisition profitably, ideally in a business growing from £20m+ towards £100m+

  • Ownership of a multi-million pound annual media budget across several channels

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in paid social and paid search, and experience across video, programmatic and affiliates

  • Experience with incrementality testing, media mix modelling and multi-touch attribution, and using them to make budget decisions

  • Experience launching paid media in new international markets

  • A strong understanding of performance creative and creator-led advertising

  • Experience selecting and managing agency partners and growth technology

  • A track record of using AI to improve marketing performance and efficiency, including AI-led buying such as Meta Advantage+ and Performance Max, creative production and analysis

  • Experience leading a team through AI adoption, with measurable gains in output, speed or cost

  • Strong working knowledge of Shopify, GA4 and attribution tools

Competencies

  • Commercially sharp: thinks in CAC, payback and contribution, and makes budget calls on marginal return

  • Analytical: highly numerate, tests and measures everything, and questions the data

  • Customer-focused: understands who the customer is, what they respond to and what they are worth

  • Brand-minded: builds the TALA brand through paid media as well as driving sales

  • Entrepreneurial: moves at pace, works lean and thrives in a high-growth environment

  • Collaborative: works across brand, creative, product, merchandising and finance, and brings people with them

  • Leader and communicator: develops talent and explains performance clearly to senior leadership

What we can offer:

  • 25 days holiday a year plus bank holidays

  • Very generous employee discount after probation period

  • Nominated Friends & Family Discount

  • Clothing allowance spending gift

  • Class Pass or Gym Flex membership

  • Health Shield

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity pay

  • Charity fundraising match of up to £1,000

description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

 

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does the New Business Director (Global)  do a WPP Production?

The role

The New Business Director plays a pivotal role in shaping and driving growth for WPP Production, defining how we win high-value, complex opportunities and shaping the strategic direction of our growth function.

This is a highly strategic role, responsible for designing integrated solutions, evolving go-to-market propositions and building a repeatable growth engine that enables the business to win consistently across markets and opportunity types.

You will lead the strategic direction and narrative for priority opportunities — ensuring that every response is clearly positioned, commercially compelling and aligned to client needs. You will be accountable for the quality and consistency of our narrative and strategic output across all pitches, setting the standard for how we articulate our value.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will play a key role in driving integration across Media, Creative and Production, shaping how we bring together capabilities to deliver differentiated client solutions.

Beyond individual opportunities, you will take a broader view of growth — defining where we should focus, how we prioritise opportunities, and how we scale success globally. This includes evolving our approach to pitches, refining commercial models and embedding best practice ways of working across the team.

This is a high-impact role with visibility across the business, suited to someone who thrives in complexity, operates with a high level of autonomy, and is motivated by driving measurable growth and business impact at scale.

Key areas of responsibility

  • Define and lead the strategic direction for priority, high-value opportunities, ensuring a clear and differentiated approach to winning
  • Accountable for the narrative quality and strategic standard across all pitches, setting the benchmark for how we articulate our value
  • Design end-to-end client solutions and commercial models, including operating models, pricing approach and value proposition
  • Lead the development of go-to-market propositions, continuously evolving how WPP Production positions itself in market
  • Work with the Global Chief Growth Officer to define and drive the global growth strategy for WPP Production, identifying priority markets, opportunity types and areas of focus
  • Define and influence where we focus our growth efforts, ensuring time and resource are prioritised on the highest value opportunities
  • Analyse pipeline, performance and market trends to identify where growth is coming from — and where it should come from next
  • Partner with senior leadership to shape growth priorities, targets and investment decisions
  • Drive improved conversion, efficiency and revenue impact across the new business pipeline through stronger strategic positioning and approach
  • Build and scale a repeatable growth engine, embedding frameworks, playbooks, tools and best practice that enable teams globally to win consistently without central dependency
  • Act as a "pitch doctor", stepping into critical opportunities to strengthen narrative, structure and overall response quality
  • Present and represent WPP Production in senior client meetings & pitch meetings
  • Drive cross-WPP integration, ensuring seamless collaboration across Media, Creative and Production
  • Identify and embed new ways of working, improving how we approach, structure and deliver pitches
  • Lead on innovation in growth, including exploring the use of AI and new technologies to enhance team capability and efficiency
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP and key client organisations
  • Develop and scale team capability, through coaching, mentoring and training

 

What good looks like (key requirements)

  • Significant experience (typically 10+ years) in new business, growth or strategy roles within a creative, production or agency environment
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, with a proven ability to define how complex opportunities are approached and won
  • Outstanding writing and storytelling ability, with experience leading narrative development for high-value, multi-disciplinary pitches
  • Strong commercial acumen, with experience designing and influencing commercial models, pricing strategies and value propositions
  • Proven experience leading large, complex and high-value pitch processes, often involving multiple stakeholders and disciplines
  • Confident and credible communicator, with experience presenting to senior clients and influencing at leadership level
  • Comfortable operating at pace and under pressure, managing multiple high-stakes opportunities simultaneously
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing ecosystems, including the intersection of media, creative and production
  • Able to influence and align senior stakeholders, often with competing priorities, to a single direction
  • Experience shaping or evolving go-to-market propositions and strategic positioning
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, bringing structure and clarity to complex challenges
  • A proactive and solutions-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Experience developing and mentoring team members, with a focus on building capability and scaling impact
  • Curious and forward-thinking, with an interest in innovation, AI and the future of content and production

#LI-HYBRID

#LI-RH1

 

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
description:
SumUp | Senior Data Analyst - Consumer Growth | London, United Kingdom

Competitive salary · Office-first

This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK.

About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates

If you want to be the person leadership turns to for an honest read of the business, and to see your analysis change real product and commercial decisions, this role is for you. 

What you'll do 

Shape commercial decisions 

  • Own the SumUp Consumer KPI framework end to end — defining which metrics matter, how they're measured and how they connect customer behaviour to commercial outcomes. 
  • Evaluate the quality of our growth: CAC, source attribution, channel performance and downstream customer value, separating headline growth from sustainable growth. 
  • Work with Risk and Anti-Fraud so fraud, abuse and economic loss are built into how we judge customers, channels and markets. 

Drive product decisions 

  • Diagnose where customers drop out between acquisition and activation, and which behaviours drive repeat usage, retention and lifetime value. 
  • Design and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer and commercial impact. 
  • Help Product Managers size opportunities and judge whether shipped features delivered the outcomes they promised. 

Influence with data 

  • Act as an independent analytical partner to Consumer leadership and to Product, Growth, Finance and Risk — proactively surfacing trends, risks and opportunities rather than waiting for requests. Challenge assumptions, metric definitions and interpretations constructively when the evidence points elsewhere. 
  • Build trusted reporting and help teams self-serve routine questions, so your time goes on the problems that matter most. 
  • Use AI and LLM-assisted techniques to speed up analysis, customer understanding and insight generation. 

You'll be great for this role if… 

  • You form your own view of why something happened and what the business should do about it — not just report what happened. 
  • You've influenced senior stakeholders with data, including changing a decision or overturning a long-held assumption. 
  • You understand the economics of a digital consumer product: acquisition, activation, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and unit economics. 
  • You're fluent in product analytics — funnel, cohort, segmentation and behavioural analysis. 
  • You have strong SQL and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar. 
  • You use a visualisation tool such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI to build reporting that stakeholders actually rely on. 
  • You turn ambiguous questions into structured analysis and tell a clear, concise story to technical and non technical audiences alike. 
  • You prioritise by business impact and are comfortable managing several stakeholders and workstreams at once. 

Bonus points if you have: 

  • Experience in consumer fintech, banking, payments or financial services 
  • Growth or marketing analytics experience, including attribution, CAC and channel performance (e.g. AppsFlyer, Google Analytics) 
  • Experience modelling customer lifetime value or unit economics 
  • Experience partnering with fraud, abuse or risk teams 
  • Depth in experimentation design and the statistics behind it 
  • Familiarity with dbt or experience working alongside Analytics Engineers 
  • Python or R for advanced analysis

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental

🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta

💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)

🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

title: Senior Enterprise Security Engineer
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Role

As a Senior Enterprise Security Engineer, you will lead the design and operation of security controls that protect our internal networks, workforce identities, endpoints and corporate systems. You will be working globally with security teams across US, EU and APAC, delivering against our goals and objectives - reducing risk and maturing controls.

As a Senior, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy. You will define technical direction, make architectural decisions, and deliver complex security initiatives end-to-end. You will be expected to balance risk reduction with usability, ensuring controls are robust without impeding employee productivity.

This role focuses on Identity and Access Management (IAM), Endpoint security (EDR), Network Security, logging and detection engineering, and secure SaaS enablement. You will work closely with IT, Legal, Privacy, Engineering and business stakeholders to embed security as a default practice across the organisation.

Security controls will be aligned to recognised frameworks such as the CIS Critical Security Controls and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Control Implementation: Design, deploy, and maintain core corporate security controls, including phishing-resistant MFA, Just-In-Time (JIT) access, strict role-based access control (RBAC), zero-trust architectures, device and identity bound proofing and modern network isolation.

  • Tooling Ownership: Serve as the technical owner for a broad suite of corporate security systems, managing deployments, configurations, and API integrations for tools across the corporate environment.

  • Technical Leadership: Lead and implement the technical strategy for Endpoint Device trust, Data Loss Prevention, Intellectual property storage, and SaaS application security. Alongside wider corporate security technical controls.

  • Automation & Engineering: Write scripts and build tools to automate security workflows, incident response tasks, and audit evidence collection for compliance.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with IT and business operations to integrate security tools into everyday workflows. Guide non-security teams to adopt secure baselines (e.g., CIS Benchmarks) as standard practice.

  • Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, and help improve the team's engineering standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years' experience in Security Engineering, Corporate Security, Detection & Response, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience administering IAM platforms (e.g. Okta, GoogleWorkspace).

  • Deep hands-on experience with GoogleWorkspace products

  • Practical hands-on experience with Cloud platforms (e.g AWS, GCP)

  • Relevant and practical experience with Infrastructure-as-code (e.g Terraform)

  • Experience implementing modern authentication standards (FIDO2, WebAuthn, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect).

  • Practical experience securing macOS, Windows and Linux endpoints using MDM and EDR/XDR tooling.

  • Experience operating SIEM and/or SOAR platforms and tuning detection logic.

  • Experience with vulnerability management and patch governance.

  • Ability to write production-quality automation scripts.

  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with SASE or Zero Trust Network Access platforms.

  • Hands on experience deploying applications into K8 and Docker environments

  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and SaaS security governance.

  • Advanced detection engineering or SOAR playbook development.

  • Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, CISM, GIAC).

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Account Executive - UK
description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.


Who We Need

As our Founding Account Executive in the UK at Rillet, you’ll be at the forefront of transforming how high-growth companies run their finances. Your mission is to drive revenue growth by building deep, strategic relationships with CFOs, finance leaders, and accounting teams — helping them realize the full potential of Rillet. You’ll work with everything from fast-scaling startups to global enterprises, tailoring your approach and refining your craft along the way.

This role blends business acumen, strategic sales expertise, and a strong grasp of AI-powered automation — empowering the world’s most ambitious companies to achieve zero-day close and operate with real-time financial clarity.

What You'll Do

  • Build the GTM playbook
    You’ll play a key role in building the playbook and driving our GTM motion. Specifically, you’ll refine our process playbook, run message tests, perform ROI comparison analyses, experiment to find new and unexpected channels, and more. You’ll take full ownership with a scrappy approach and double down when you see signs of success.

  • Execute relentlessly
    Work cross-functionally to provide front-line prospect feedback to founders and product teams in near real-time. Perform strategic, personalized outreach to priority accounts and drive opportunities forward from SQL to signed deal. You’ll roll up your sleeves and accelerate velocity.

  • Represent Rillet
    You’ll be the face of the company — applying high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is exceptional. You’re comfortable selling to users with deep finance and accounting expertise and will deepen your domain knowledge in the process.


Who We're Looking For

  • 4–5+ years of AE experience at a top-tier SaaS startup, with a track record of driving complex, multi-threaded deals from discovery to close. Experience with ERP is a plus.

  • Exceptional communicator and relationship builder who simplifies complex concepts, earns executive sponsorship, and champions customer success.

  • Proactive self-starter who hustles, drives initiatives beyond core responsibilities, and thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

  • Trusted product expert and customer advocate who guides clients through evaluations, deployments, and adoption of AI solutions.

  • Strategic operator who builds pipeline, quantifies business value, and drives measurable ROI for clients.

  • Detail-oriented collaborator who delivers actionable feedback to internal teams to improve product and process outcomes.

  • Previous experience as a Founding AE is also a plus.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

Vice President of Sales, EMEA

CreatorIQ is seeking a Vice President of Sales, EMEA to lead our Enterprise Sales team and accelerate our expansion across the EU. In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Lead, develop, and strengthen a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives, creating clear expectations, strong coaching practices, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

  • Build and execute an EMEA enterprise sales strategy focused on net-new customer acquisition, and growth within existing enterprise accounts.

  • Develop a strong, sustainable pipeline and maintain forecasting discipline that improves accuracy, visibility, and predictability across the region.

  • Accelerate enterprise revenue growth by leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and helping the team effectively engage C-suite executives and senior decision-makers.

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with enterprise customers and prospects, serving as a senior commercial partner and trusted advisor throughout the full customer lifecycle.

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and other cross-functional teams to align go-to-market priorities, support customer growth, and strengthen CreatorIQ’s position in the market.

CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth, helping global brands and agencies transform creator marketing into an intelligence-driven growth engine. More than 1,300 organizations—including Dentsu, Delta Air Lines, Google, Beiersdorf, Nestlé, and Wella—rely on CreatorIQ as the infrastructure to run and scale their creator programs globally. That is…until now.

At Skinnify (www.skinnify.co), we make clothing with built-in resistance—leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more—that turn everyday movements into a passive workout. In just three years, we've grown from 0 to over 150,000 customers, and we're just getting started.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Imn7tqGmLXZxcpNBRI0mxYA6ayPwLT7j/view?usp=sharing

We're looking for a Hiring Manager who is an expert at finding amazing employees for us, from poaching top talent at other companies to onboarding them smoothly, as we continue to scale internationally.

🔹 Your Responsibilities

  • Hiring (especially poaching team members from other companies)

  • Onboarding & offboarding team members

✔️Someone with excellent people skills

✔️ Experience as a Hiring Manager at a $10M+ annual revenue e-commerce company

✔️ Expert at finding amazing employees, including poaching top talent from other companies.

✔️ Excellent organizational skills with exceptional attention to details

✔️ Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

✔️ Experience working with remote international teams

💼 Position Details

  • Position: Hiring Manager

  • Employment: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

  • Location: Fully Remote

  • Contract: Long-term

💡 Why Join Skinnify?

📈 Join a Hyper-Growth Brand – From 0 to 150,000+ customers in 3 years. Your hires will directly influence sales and brand growth.

🚀 Real Career Growth – Your trajectory here is whatever you make of it. One team member went from video editor to creative strategist and doubled their salary. Another started in customer support and now runs the entire customer support team. We promote from within and invest in people who want to grow.

💼 Full Flexibility – Work from anywhere, anytime. We run on trust and results, not time tracking - as long as the work gets done, your hours are yours.

🧠 Learning Budget – Courses, books, consulting calls — we cover it. Many team members book calls with founders of big ecommerce brands or managers at major companies through platforms like intro.co and mentorpass.co.

⭐ Loved by the Team – Rated 5 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor (https://www.glassdoor.de/Bewertungen/Skinnify-Bewertungen-E10737192.htm)

🏋️‍♀️ The Skinnify Story

Our founder Christian grew up in Frankfurt, Germany. Looking around, he noticed something striking: so many of the women in his life — his mom, his sister, his friends — wanted to get fitter, lose weight, and build muscle, but kept running into the same wall. They didn't have the time, the motivation, or the consistency to make the gym work.

The idea hit him during his own workout. He was using resistance bands and thought: what if these were built into everyday clothing? What if women could get the benefits of resistance training passively — while walking the kids to school, cooking dinner, or sitting at their desk? Fitness without the extra time or effort.

The idea was personal too. Christian was a difficult kid growing up and put his mom through a lot. She barely had time for herself, let alone the gym. He built Skinnify for women like her: busy, hardworking, often overlooked — so they could do something good for their bodies just by getting dressed.

🛍️ Our Products

What started with a single product — leggings with built-in resistance bands — has grown into a full collection of resistance-integrated clothing: leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more. We're on a mission to revolutionize how women do fitness by turning daily life into a workout.

🌟 Skinnify's Core Values

💡 Innovation – We design new, groundbreaking clothing with built-in resistance to revolutionize fitness.

🔥 Effectiveness – Our products help people burn more calories & get fitter with every step.

🌍 Accessibility – We make fitness accessible to everyone — even the busiest and least motivated.

🎉 Fun – We make exercise feel effortless and enjoyable.

✅ Quality – Our products are built to last — high-quality, durable, and reliable.

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Context

We've closed a $20M Series A with Index Ventures and we're deployed in 40+ hospitals across France, with international expansion underway. Our product works, our clients are happy, and the pipeline is growing — but our marketing function doesn't exist yet.

This is our first marketing hire. You'll build the function from scratch and report directly to Paul (our CEO), working closely with Victoire on everything that touches Sales.

Your mission

Build Parallel's marketing from zero: give us real visibility in the healthcare market, and equip our Sales team with the assets they need to close.

Outcomes

In your first 3 months

  • Parallel has a consistent LinkedIn presence — at least 3 posts a week, founders included

  • Sales has a complete asset library: an up-to-date deck, a one-pager, objection-handling materials

  • A newsletter is live and sent regularly to prospects and clients

In your first 6 months

  • Parallel is present and visible at 2–3 key healthcare industry events (SantExpo or equivalent)

  • A content pipeline is running: case studies, op-eds, product announcements

  • Client communication is structured: onboarding emails, release notes, an upsell narrative in place

In your first 12 months

  • Parallel is a recognized voice in hospital digital transformation — prospects have heard of us before the first Sales call, and inbound starts coming in organically

You you are :

This job is for you if:

  • You write well in French and English, and you can get to the point

  • You can produce visuals on your own, without waiting on a designer

  • You're comfortable with email/CRM tools

  • You know how to prioritize in a fast-moving, still-unstructured environment

  • You're curious about the healthcare sector

  • Above all: strong writing, sharp synthesis, and proactivity — these aren't negotiable

You'll be embedded in the Sales team, reporting to Paul. There's no fixed plan to hire someone under you on day one, but managing a freelancer or intern down the line is on the table if it makes sense — to free up your time for higher-impact work, not as a given.

Hiring process

  1. Chat with Wallerand our recruiter - 30'

  2. Victoire our Sales Lead - 30'

  3. Case study, on-site + Chat with paul Paul - 1h30

  4. Ref calls

  5. Offer

Why should you join us?

  • You're the first marketing hire — everything you build, from positioning to process, is yours to define

  • Direct access to the CEO and a real seat at the table on Sales-impact decisions

  • No promises on progression, but a real trajectory if you prove your impact

  • Competitive salary + equity, Alan, Swile, and Apple equipment

  • A product that already works, real clients, and a market (hospital finance) where the upside is enormous

 
 
 

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

By selling directly to consumers, we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior or Lead Security Engineer (Detection & Response) to build out the next generation of detection systems.

You'll sit within the team responsible for security across our IT and cloud environment, spanning AWS, identity, endpoints, SaaS and data center infrastructure. You'll own security monitoring and detection end-to-end: anticipating how our systems could be compromised, ensuring we have the right telemetry to see it, and building the detections and response workflows to act on it.

Think of it like SRE for security. We want someone who can answer questions like: Has this account been compromised? Is someone accessing AWS who shouldn't be? Has an attacker moved laterally through our network? How would we know?

You'll also lead investigations and incident response, automate repetitive security work, and work with IT and Engineering to fix the underlying problems you uncover.

Responsibilities

  • Own security monitoring and detection across AWS, identity, endpoints, SaaS, networks and data center environments
  • Build and maintain the telemetry and logging pipelines needed to detect security incidents, and continuously test and improve detection coverage
  • Lead security investigations and incident response from detection through containment, recovery and post-mortem

  • Build automation to improve detection, investigation and response, making effective use of AI and emerging tools to improve efficiency and capabilities.

  • Develop and test incident response playbooks and continuously improve our response capability
  • Implement and enhance internal AI agents and security bots that assist with monitoring, investigations, reporting, and other security operation tasks.

Requirements

  • Significant hands-on experience in detection engineering, security engineering, incident response, threat hunting or a similar technical role
  • Strong understanding of cloud environments, ideally AWS, and how to monitor them for unauthorised or suspicious activity
  • Strong networking fundamentals and an understanding of how attackers move through networks and systems

title: Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais (H/F)
description:
Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais  (H/F)

À propos de notre client

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Pour accélérer ses projets de développement, notre client recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) R&D en conception d'équipements d'essais.  Vous prendrez en charge la conception, la mise au point et la validation de cellules d'essais haute température et haute pression, un sujet stratégique pour l'entreprise et ses clients.

Rattaché(e) à la direction des opérations, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe qui conçoit aujourd'hui les équipements et dépose les brevets de l'entreprise.

Répartition indicative du temps : environ 70 à 80 % conception et développement, 20 à 30 % laboratoire (montage et validation de vos équipements).

Dans une structure à taille humaine, vous suivrez vos développements de la conception jusqu'aux tests, avant leur transfert à l'équipe de production.

Vos missions

Conception et développement d'équipements d’essais

  • Concevoir de nouvelles cellules et de nouveaux dispositifs d'essais, notamment pour des conditions de haute température et de haute pression.
  • Résoudre les problématiques techniques associées : instrumentation et capteurs, étanchéité, tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consulter les fournisseurs et sous-traitants, et suivre la fabrication des pièces.
  • Améliorer les équipements existants, notamment leur ergonomie et leur facilité d'utilisation en production.

Mise au point et validation

  • Monter les équipements développés et réaliser leurs tests de validation au laboratoire.
  • Interpréter les résultats expérimentaux et vérifier leur cohérence.
  • Transférer les équipements validés à l'équipe de production et l'accompagner dans leur prise en main.

Documentation et propriété intellectuelle

  • Rédiger la documentation technique, les rapports et les comptes-rendus, et les présenter, en français comme en anglais.
  • Participer à la veille technique et à la rédaction des documents de protection (brevets, enveloppes Soleau).

Vie du laboratoire

  • Comprendre les essais réalisés au laboratoire pour concevoir des équipements adaptés à leurs besoins.
  • Contribuer à l'activité du labo et à l'amélioration continue, dans le respect de la démarche qualité ISO 9001.

Requirements

Compétences techniques

  • Conception mécanique et maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO.
  • Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure.
  • Compréhension des grandeurs physiques et physico-chimiques.
  • Rédaction technique et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Savoir-être

  • Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main un sujet de bout en bout.
  • Rigueur, notamment dans les phases d'essais.
  • Polyvalence et goût du concret : vous aimez concevoir autant que tester vous-même vos équipements.
  • Communication proactive, en particulier pour remonter et résoudre les difficultés rencontrées.
  • Envie d'apprendre et de s'investir dans une petite structure.

Formation et expérience

  • Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent Bac +5 en génie mécanique, conception, instrumentation ou mesures physiques.
  • Expérience d'environ 5 ans en conception d'équipements, en bureau d'études ou en R&D. Les profils plus juniors avec une première expérience significative en conception seront étudiés.
  • Une expérience sur des équipements soumis à des contraintes de température ou de pression est un vrai plus.

Benefits

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique.

description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Community Manager (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Communication à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de Janvier 2027. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Rattaché(e) à la Social Media Manager, vous l’accompagnerez dans la gestion quotidienne de nos réseaux sociaux. Vous serez responsable de la création, de la planification et de la gestion du contenu sur nos plateformes de médias sociaux pour renforcer notre image de marque et engager notre communauté en ligne.

Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

  • Préparation, planification des contenus et gestion des prises de parole quotidiennes (timeline & stories) ;
  • Copywriting des captions sur Instagram ;
  • Proposition et déploiement des actions d’animation de la communauté ;
  • Veille des tendances digitales et sociales ainsi que des contenus UGC;
  • Analyse des performances.

Requirements

Profil

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e), en école de communication, en école de commerce, ou équivalent universitaire et vous recherchez un stage. Idéalement, vous justifiez d’une première expérience dans un domaine proche ;
  • Vous avez le goût des belles images et des mots qui inspirent ;) ;
  • Vous avez un vrai intérêt pour les réseaux sociaux et vous les utilisez quotidiennement ;
  • Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre esprit de synthèse, rigueur et attention aux détails ;
  • Vous êtes curieux/se, proactif/ve et vous avez l’esprit d’équipe.

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.

Responsable Partenaires Ecosystème Santé (x/f/m)
Programmatic Analyst - Alternance (H/F/X)
description:
Biggie est l’agence globale de stratégie et activation media & marketing de Biggie group, groupe international indépendant de solutions marketing intégrées. Biggie est le fruit du rapprochement de plusieurs entités du groupe : l’expert en activations digitales Gamned!, l’agence conseil en achat média Repeat ainsi que l’agence média & cabinet de conseil en marketing 3qtz.
 
Avec pour signature « Partners in growth », Biggie ambitionne d’être partenaire de la croissance des marques, en mettant l’excellence stratégique et opérationnelle au service de leur performance et en leur proposant un accompagnement sur-mesure (stratégie marketing, planning stratégique, data & analyse, media, performance digitale, création et adaptation de contenus ou encore consulting business) pour répondre à leurs problématiques business.
 
L’agence regroupe 300 experts, dont 150 en France, présents dans 7 pays à travers 9 bureaux internationaux (Paris, Marseille, Bruxelles, Milan, Genève, Zurich, Prague, Dubaï et Sao Paulo). Pour en savoir plus : www.biggie.co

🗒️ Missions


En tant que Programmatic Analyst, tu participes activement aux opérations, à l'analyse et au développement commercial de notre activité programmatique, en lien direct avec les équipes Trading, MediaBuying, Sales et Conseil.

Tu interviens sur des missions variées et à fort impact, allant de la création d'offres programmatiques, en passant par l'analyse stratégique des résultats et le suivi financier.

Au quotidien, tu t'occuperas de :

• Template de setup & vérification des créas : Préparer et compléter les templates de setup pour chaque nouvelle campagne, contrôler la conformité des créations publicitaires par rapport aux spécifications techniques des régies et DSP, et réaliser des audits pour identifier les éventuelles anomalies.

• Partage de résultats & bilans de campagne : Préparer les supports de bilan, compiler les données de performance issues des DSP et outils de reporting, participer aux réunions de restitution avec les clients et formuler des recommandations pour les futures campagnes.

• Analyse des résultats des top campagnes : Analyser en profondeur les résultats des campagnes les plus stratégiques, identifier les facteurs clés de performance et produire des insights actionnables pour nourrir les équipes commerciales.

• Analyse macro des résultats : Réaliser une analyse transversale de l'ensemble des campagnes pour identifier les tendances globales, les patterns de succès et les causes récurrentes d'échec, et alimenter une base de connaissance interne.

En tant que data scientist, vous rejoindrez l'équipe Pulsar aux côtés de trois autres data scientists.

🎯 MISSIONS

Veepee développe des algorithmes de pointe en matière de prévision et de tarification, qui constituent des priorités stratégiques pour l’entreprise.

Votre stage sera axé sur l’amélioration de la précision de nos modèles de tarification et de prévision, en travaillant sur des caractéristiques transversales.
Il existe de nombreuses pistes de recherche prometteuses pour améliorer nos algorithmes d’apprentissage automatique, notamment :

  • Bac +5 en data sciences
  • Solides connaissances en Python
  • Maîtrise de SQL
  • Bonne compréhension de l'apprentissage automatique (évaluation ML, classification, régression, etc.)
  • Intérêt pour les bonnes pratiques en génie logiciel
  • Atout : connaissance de dbt, Git, Docker, Kubernetes
  • Excellentes compétences en communication en français et en anglais
  • Capacité à identifier, analyser et résoudre des problèmes
  • Autonomie, curiosité et volonté de mettre en production des solutions
  • Envie d'apprendre de nouvelles technologies et approches scientifiques

title: Accountant (m/f/d)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accountant (m/f/d) based in France.

As an Accountant, you will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the accounting operations of German entities within an international software group. You will oversee day-to-day accounting activities, contribute to month-end and year-end closing processes, and ensure compliance with German accounting standards and tax regulations. Working closely with the finance team, external tax advisors, and payroll providers, you will help deliver reliable financial reporting and maintain strong internal controls. You will also contribute to budgeting, variance analysis, and financial performance monitoring to support informed business decisions. This fully remote opportunity offers a hands-on environment where you can improve existing processes, bring structure to financial operations, and take ownership of meaningful responsibilities. It is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented accounting professional seeking to grow within an international, entrepreneurial, and collaborative team.


Accountabilities:
  • Manage day-to-day accounting activities for German legal entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial records.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing procedures, including journal entries, accounting adjustments, and financial analysis.
  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and support the review of account balances to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Follow up with vendors regarding missing invoices, prepare cost accruals, and contribute to profit and loss (P&L) reviews.
  • Process supplier payments and bank transfers, ensuring that the appropriate approvals and internal procedures are followed.
  • Reconcile intercompany transactions and investigate discrepancies to maintain consistent financial records across entities.
  • Prepare German VAT filings, including Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung and Zusammenfassende Meldung, and support payroll tax declarations (Lohnsteuer-Anmeldung) in collaboration with external payroll providers and tax advisors.
  • Assist with the preparation of annual financial statements in accordance with German Commercial Code (HGB) requirements, as well as statutory audits and tax filings.
  • Maintain and strengthen internal financial controls, accounting procedures, and compliance practices.
  • Review and improve existing accounting processes, resolve outstanding items, clean up historical ledger discrepancies, and establish more efficient financial workflows.
  • Prepare financial KPIs and management reports, validating data accuracy and consistency before submission.
  • Support monthly variance analysis by comparing actual results against budgets and forecasts, investigating discrepancies, and providing relevant insights.
  • Collaborate with the wider finance team on daily accounting operations, reporting activities, process improvements, and special projects.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of professional accounting experience, including hands-on responsibility for German accounting practices under HGB and German tax requirements.
  • Experience in the software, technology, or Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) industry.
  • Solid understanding of accrual accounting, financial reconciliations, journal entries, closing procedures, and financial reporting.
  • Practical knowledge of German VAT requirements and familiarity with payroll tax declarations and statutory reporting obligations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with the ability to work confidently with financial data and accounting reports.
  • Experience with NetSuite or similar accounting and enterprise resource planning systems is an advantage.
  • Experience managing multiple legal entities or multi-currency accounting is a plus.
  • A professional qualification in accounting, bookkeeping, or a related discipline is desirable.
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and reliability, with a commitment to maintaining high standards in financial documentation and reporting.
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset and willingness to resolve historical accounting issues, organize incomplete records, and improve existing processes.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and take ownership of responsibilities in a fully remote environment.
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills, including the ability to collaborate proactively with colleagues, external advisors, and service providers across remote teams.
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn new systems, expand responsibilities, and develop professionally over time.
  • Fluency in both German and English, written and spoken.
  • Residence in Europe and legal authorization to work in the country of residence. Being based in or near Berlin is an advantage.

    • Benefits:

  • Fully remote working arrangement: Work remotely from an eligible location within Europe.
  • International working environment: Collaborate with finance professionals and stakeholders across an international software group.
  • Entrepreneurial team culture: Benefit from a hands-on environment that encourages ownership, initiative, and practical problem-solving.
  • Professional development: Expand your accounting expertise and gain exposure to international financial operations, reporting, and process improvement.
  • Meaningful responsibilities: Take ownership of day-to-day accounting activities and contribute directly to the accuracy and efficiency of financial operations.
  • Career growth opportunities: Develop your skills and take on additional responsibilities as you gain experience.
  • Collaborative finance team: Work closely with finance colleagues, external tax advisors, and payroll providers.
  • Organizational stability: Enjoy the opportunity to work within an established international group while retaining the benefits of an agile, entrepreneurial team.

title: Account Executive DACH (Swiss German-speaking) / (German + French-speaking)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive DACH (Swiss German-speaking) / (German + French-speaking) based in France.

Help ambitious Swiss businesses expand internationally by removing the complexities of cross-border hiring and workforce management. As an Account Executive, you will own the full B2B sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation, closing, and successful customer onboarding. You will advise founders, HR leaders, and other decision-makers on workforce solutions that enable them to hire talent across borders compliantly. Working in a remote-first, international sales team, you will build a strong pipeline, develop strategic relationships, and turn complex business challenges into commercial opportunities. This role is designed for a results-driven sales professional who combines consultative selling with proactive outbound prospecting and confident deal management. You will have the autonomy to manage your territory, exceed ambitious sales targets, and contribute to the growth of a globally connected business.


Accountabilities:

Take ownership of the complete sales process across assigned Swiss accounts, building a strong pipeline and helping companies understand the value of international workforce solutions. Work closely with prospects and internal sales colleagues to identify business needs, navigate complex buying processes, and consistently achieve commercial objectives.

  • Manage the full sales cycle, from initial prospecting and discovery through qualification, negotiation, closing, and successful customer onboarding.

  • Develop and manage relationships with Swiss companies seeking to expand internationally and hire talent across borders.

  • Conduct thorough discovery conversations to understand hiring plans, business priorities, expansion timelines, and potential compliance risks.

  • Engage founders, HR leaders, and other key stakeholders, building internal champions and demonstrating the business value of proposed solutions to Finance, Legal, and executive decision-makers.

  • Apply structured qualification methodologies, such as MEDDICC, to assess opportunities, prioritize qualified prospects, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

  • Generate new business through proactive outbound activities, including cold calling, personalized outreach, and targeted prospecting around relevant business events and funding announcements.

  • Collaborate with Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to identify and pursue high-value opportunities within the assigned territory.

  • Maintain deal momentum through effective follow-ups, confident negotiations, and clear communication throughout the buying process.

  • Use AI tools to improve prospect research, outreach quality, productivity, and sales execution.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records, including pipeline activity, opportunity progress, and sales forecasts.

  • Consistently meet or exceed sales quotas while taking accountability for individual performance and continuously improving through feedback.

  • Contribute to team knowledge-sharing, collaborate with colleagues across international markets, and apply lessons learned from successful and unsuccessful deals.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a proactive, commercially minded sales professional with proven B2B SaaS closing experience and the confidence to engage senior decision-makers. You should combine strong discovery and qualification skills with a willingness to prospect independently, manage complex sales conversations, and deliver measurable results in a fast-paced, remote environment.

    • At least 1 year of experience closing B2B SaaS deals as an Account Executive, with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.

    • Ability to substantiate sales performance with clear metrics, including quota attainment and closed-won results.

    • Native-level Swiss German proficiency and business-fluent English for the Swiss German-speaking profile; alternatively, fluency in both German and French for the German- and French-speaking profile.

    • Strong discovery, qualification, and consultative selling skills, with experience using methodologies such as MEDDICC.

    • Confidence and persistence in outbound sales, including cold calling, personalized prospecting, and engaging busy founders and senior stakeholders.

    • Ability to uncover customer needs, communicate business value, address objections, and navigate complex decision-making processes.

    • Strong negotiation and closing skills, with a proactive approach to maintaining deal momentum and achieving sales targets.

    • Familiarity with AI-powered tools and the ability to integrate them into daily sales workflows.

    • Experience using HubSpot or a comparable CRM, with strong organizational skills and consistent data hygiene.

    • Coachability, adaptability, and a willingness to seek feedback and implement improvements quickly.

    • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and time-management skills in a distributed working environment.

    • An existing professional network among Swiss founders or HR leaders is an advantage.

    • Previous experience in HR technology, payroll, Employer of Record (EOR), or other compliance-intensive solutions is a plus.

    • Additional French language skills are beneficial for engaging customers in French-speaking Switzerland.

    • Creativity and resourcefulness in identifying new ways to reach decision-makers and generate qualified opportunities.

      • Competitive compensation starting from €50,000 gross annual on-target earnings (OTE), comprising 60% base salary and 40% variable bonus, depending on location, skills, and experience.

      • Fully remote working arrangement within approximately two hours of Central European Time (CET).

      • WorkFlex program offering flexibility to work from different locations, subject to applicable policies.

      • Dedicated Well-Being Day to rest, recharge, and support personal well-being.

      • Subsidized gym memberships to support physical health and an active lifestyle.

About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

  • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

  • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

  • Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

  • Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

  • Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

  • Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

  • Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management

  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements

  • Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization

  • Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

 

Skills and Experience Required:

  • BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role

  • Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus

  • Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements

  • Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

  • Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

  • Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements

  • Proven team player, with the ability to:
    (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team
    (ii) Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams

  • Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

  • Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus

  • Professional working language is in English.

title: Responsable Qualité Multi-Sites - Piles à Combustible
description:
About EHG

EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide.

Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company.

 

The opportunity

We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.

You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US.

 

What you'll own

  • One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland.

  • Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one.

  • In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment.

  • Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves.

  • Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria.

  • Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other.

  • Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities.

  • Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant.

  • Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly.

  • Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow.

 

What we're looking for

Core experience

  • Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance.

  • Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one.

  • Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability.

  • Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard.

  • Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects.

  • Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage.

  • The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure.

  • Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely.

Especially compelling

  • Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience.

  • Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes.

  • Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end.

  • Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators.

  • Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth.

  • Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required.

 

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you.

  • Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland.

  • The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth.

Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States.

 

EH Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
